description: A deterministic horizontal voice-agent corpus: eight sequential workflow phases with eight unique tools each.

groups.label: Identity and consent
groups.context: Establish identity and consent before disclosing or changing protected account state.

tools.description: Look up the customer profile by a caller-supplied reference.
List verification methods allowed for this customer and channel.
Check whether supplied verification evidence matches the customer record.
Inspect the caller's current consent status for the requested operation.
Record a completed identity-verification decision with caller confirmation.
Update verified contact details after explicit caller confirmation.
Lock a customer profile when identity compromise is suspected.
Create a human identity-review case and deliver its reference.

groups.label: Membership
groups.context: Explain and modify membership only after the identity phase has completed.

tools.description: Look up the caller's current membership record.
List membership plans available to the verified caller.
Check benefits and restrictions for a selected membership plan.
Quote the exact renewal price and term without changing membership.
Renew the verified membership after explicit price and term confirmation.
Pause the verified membership for the confirmed period.
Change the verified membership to the confirmed replacement plan.
Deliver the membership-change receipt to a verified destination.

groups.label: Billing
groups.context: Explain charges before collecting money or changing a payment arrangement.

tools.description: Look up a specific invoice for the verified account.
List recent charges within a caller-selected time window.
Retrieve authoritative line-item evidence for a disputed charge.
Quote eligible payment-plan terms without enrolling the caller.
Replace the account payment method after explicit confirmation.
Collect the explicitly confirmed payment amount exactly once.
Create the selected payment plan after confirming all terms.
Deliver a billing receipt to a verified destination.

groups.label: Orders and fulfillment
groups.context: Locate and explain the order before making fulfillment changes.

tools.description: Locate an order associated with the verified caller.
List items and quantities on the selected order.
Check authoritative warehouse and carrier fulfillment status.
Quote the current expected delivery window without changing routing.
Update the shipping address when fulfillment policy allows it.
Reroute the selected shipment after confirming destination and cost.
Cancel an eligible order after explicit irreversible-action confirmation.
Deliver the latest tracking information to a verified destination.

groups.label: Returns and refunds
groups.context: Evaluate return eligibility before creating a return or promising a refund.

tools.description: Look up the return policy pinned to the selected order and item.
Check item, timing, and condition evidence for return eligibility.
List return methods allowed for this eligible item.
Estimate refund amount and timing without creating a return.
Create the confirmed return exactly once for an eligible item.
Issue the return label for the already-created return.
Schedule the confirmed carrier pickup window for the return.
Deliver the return confirmation and receipt to a verified destination.

groups.label: Scheduling
groups.context: Check availability and constraints before changing an appointment.

tools.description: List appointments belonging to the verified caller.
List appointment times matching the requested window and service.
Check provider, location, and service constraints for a proposed time.
Quote appointment options and fees without reserving a slot.
Book the explicitly confirmed appointment slot exactly once.
Move an appointment to the explicitly confirmed replacement slot.
Cancel the selected appointment after confirming any consequences.
Deliver appointment details to a verified destination.

groups.label: Communications
groups.context: Use only verified channels and preserve the caller's language and timing preferences.

tools.description: Verify whether the selected contact channel may receive this message.
Inspect delivery status for a previously sent communication.
List languages supported for the selected communication channel.
Check callback windows allowed by policy and caller preferences.
Send the confirmed message to a verified email destination.
Send the confirmed message to a verified SMS destination.
Schedule a callback in the confirmed policy-compliant window.
Transfer the live call to the confirmed queue or specialist.

groups.label: Support and escalation
groups.context: Gather current evidence before creating or escalating a support case.

tools.description: Search approved support knowledge for the caller's issue.
Inspect the verified caller's relevant prior support cases.
Check current service health for the affected product or region.
List eligible escalation queues and current service expectations.
Create a support case containing the confirmed issue summary.
Add a confirmed structured note to the active support case.
Page the on-call specialist after the escalation criteria are met.
Hand off the caller and durable context to the selected human queue.
